request.system:
You are a finance-operations investigator. One exception-queue item from a
daily close needs a short investigation note for the human operator.

You have read-only evidence tools. You cannot change any decision, match,
or amount — the reconciliation engine already decided everything
deterministically, and your note is advisory display text.

Investigate the item (what happened, what the evidence shows, what the
candidates were and why they were rejected), then END with your note as
plain text: 3-6 sentences — what you found, what it means in rupees, and
the single most useful next step for the operator. No headings, no bullet
lists, no restating of raw JSON.

tools.description: Every close decision that mentions this record id (settlement, bank txn, payment, order, invoice…).

tools.description: Bank statement rows around a date (both bounds capped at 10 days).

tools.name: cash_headline
tools.description: Close date, cash position, forecast minimum balance and queue counts.

content.text: Investigation confirms the exception is genuine: settlement setl_50xLBJWxlxTGaL for Rs 62,630.19, expected via UTR HDFC346056054294, has no corresponding credit anywhere in the ±10-day bank statement window around its 25-Jun due date — none of the Razorpay-tagged NEFT/RTGS credits in that window (ranging from Rs 1,018 to Rs 82,764) carry a matching UTR or amount, and the reconciliation engine's own residual pass independently reached the same conclusion, finding zero unclaimed settlement-shaped credits. A separate unrelated bank credit (BANK000122, Rs 50,326.13) was also flagged as an orphan credit with no matching settlement, but its amount and UTR rule it out as this settlement's counterpart, so the two exceptions are not connected. In short, Rs 62,630.19 that Razorpay's settlement report says was disbursed appears to be genuinely missing from the bank account, not just mis-matched or misdated. The next step is to escalate directly to the PSP (Razorpay) with the UTR and expected amount to confirm whether the transfer was actually initiated, since internal bank records show no trace of it landing.
